description_en: Queries the statistics on vulnerabilities in asset groups
description_zh: 查询一个或多个资产分组下的漏洞数量统计值
name: GetVulStatistics

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

You can call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~) operation to query the IDs of asset groups
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的资产分组ID。多个资产分组ID使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
您可以调用[DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: group_id_list

parameters.help_en:
The type of the vulnerability whose statistics you want to query. Separate multiple types with commas (,). Valid values:

cve: Linux software vulnerability
sys: Windows system vulnerability
cms: Web-CMS vulnerability
emg: urgent vulnerability
app: vulnerability detected by using a web scanner
sca: vulnerability detected based on software component analysis
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询统计值的漏洞类型。多个漏洞类型使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：
cve：Linux软件漏洞
sys：Windows系统漏洞
cms：Web-CMS漏洞
emg：应急漏洞
app：应用漏洞（web扫描器）
sca：应用漏洞（软件成分分析）
parameters.name: type_list

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain the IDs
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

VulAsapSum.description_en: The number of vulnerabilities that have the high priority
VulAsapSum.description_zh: 漏洞修复等级为高的漏洞数量

VulLaterSum.description_en: The number of vulnerabilities that have the medium priority
VulLaterSum.description_zh: 漏洞修复等级为中的漏洞数量

VulNntfSum.description_en: The number of vulnerabilities that have the low priority
VulNntfSum.description_zh: 漏洞修复等级为低的漏洞数量
